issues.description: Module-import monkey-patch of genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE mutates a private third-party global.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flag the self-described 'temporary hack' that reaches into google-genai's private underscore-prefixed module at import time. It mutates process-global state for every consumer of pipecat, will silently break on SDK upgrade or rename, and bypasses the SDK's public surface. Fix upstream, pin the dep, or thread buffer size through a supported HttpOptions/client API.

issues.description: image.tobytes() with format='RGB' produces wrong bytes when PIL decodes as RGBA, P, or L.
issues.detail: Gemini returns PNGs that PIL opens in the source's native mode. Calling tobytes() without image.convert('RGB') while labeling the frame format='RGB' yields a buffer whose size and layout disagree with the declared format, producing garbled pixels or crashes downstream. Convert explicitly before tobytes().

issues.description: Default model bump from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent behavior change piggybacked on a feature PR.
issues.detail: Changing the default alters cost, latency, and output for every caller who relied on the prior default. All three reviewers agree this belongs in a separate, independently revertable PR with an explicit migration note rather than buried inside the image-generation feature, even though the CHANGELOG mentions it.

issues.description: Image-model detection via substring 'image' in model_name is a fragile capability proxy.
issues.detail: Gating _maybe_unset_thinking_budget on 'image' in self._model_name couples a behavioral invariant to Google's naming convention. Future models like gemini-X-image-understanding will silently match or miss. Replace with an explicit capability table or an is_image_generation_model() predicate that names and tests the rule.

issues.description: No error handling around Image.open of arbitrary server-returned inline_data bytes.
issues.detail: Malformed or non-image inline_data (audio, video, partial bytes) causes PIL to raise UnidentifiedImageError and aborts the entire context-processing loop. Wrap in try/except, inspect part.inline_data.mime_type, log the failure, and continue processing remaining parts so one bad part does not kill the stream.

issues.description: Emitting OutputImageRawFrame from GoogleLLMService extends the LLM service contract without restating it.
issues.detail: The supertype's documented postcondition is text plus tool-call streaming. Pushing image frames mid-stream strengthens what downstream pipelines must accept. Document which model classes produce image frames, the ordering guarantees relative to LLMTextFrame and aggregator boundaries, and ideally extract a small _handle_inline_data helper so the new branch is named and testable.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is NEEDS-WORK with two P0 bugs that must be fixed before merge: an import-time monkey-patch of google-genai's private READ_BUFFER_SIZE that mutates process-global SDK state, and an image-decoding path that labels bytes as RGB without converting non-RGB PIL modes. Three P1 items round out the consensus: the default-model bump is a silent behavior change that should be its own PR, substring 'image' matching is a fragile capability proxy, and there is no error handling around PIL decoding of arbitrary server bytes. A P2 contract concern remains around emitting image frames from an LLM service without restating the postcondition. Fix the hack via a supported API, convert images explicitly, split the default-model change, replace substring sniffing with a named predicate, and guard the decode path.
